text:
You need a WordPress developer to migrate your existing websites into WordPress templates while preserving the current structure and functionality.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and maintaining web applications. While my core background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I also work comfortably with website customization and front-end implementation, which makes me a strong fit for clean template-based migrations.

I can help translate your current site into a WordPress-ready structure, ensure the design stays consistent, and make the pages easy to manage going forward. I pay close attention to responsive layout, performance, and maintaining a smooth content migration process.

If you’d like, I can review the existing site structure and outline the migration approach before getting started.
